|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if [[Alderaan]] 'blown away,' may target a system; unless opponent has a capital (or [Episode I]) starship there, Objectives treat that system as a Subjugated planet. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to [[Death Star]]. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
